invariants.description: lumped visco-elastic coefficient K_tube_visco = (2/3) Γ h / (l π r0³) (the 0D form of the Kelvin-Voigt term, alastruey2011pulse Eq. 4) (relative 1e-9)

bc_sweep.rationale: Venous radii 0.8-8 mm (the toro2022cerebrospinal venous network range, which the c0(r0) law requires: r0_min <= r0 <= r0_max), lengths 0.5-20 cm, h/r0 0.02-0.1, venous E 0.2-10 MPa (petrova2025nonlinear initial to tangent moduli), K_M 1e3-1e5 Pa s, smooth-muscle fraction 0.04-0.2, venous tube-law exponents m 5-12, n -2..-1, c0 bounds 3-5 / 1-2 m/s and radius bounds 6-12 / 0.5-2 mm (r_0 = 5 mm stays inside).

baseline.reason: candidate: venous wave speeds vs radius (the toro2022cerebrospinal / muller2014global c0 range 1.5-4 m/s is a model choice, not data); no measured venous stiffness-radius dataset identified yet.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: algebraic constitutive relation with no dynamics; calibrated in the network that uses it.
